description: Executable parcel providers; research-only sources remain in registry.json until an adapter is verified.

sources.name: City of Toronto Property Boundary
sources.scope: City of Toronto municipal parcel fabric; surrounding municipalities are separate sources
sources.attribution: Contains information licensed under the Open Government Licence – Toronto.

sources.name: Bogotá IDECA/UAECD lots — CAR mirror, December 2021
sources.publisher: Corporación Autónoma Regional de Cundinamarca (CAR), using IDECA/UAECD data
sources.scope: December 2021 copy of Bogotá Distrito Capital urban and rural lots, explicitly selected for the prototype. A lot may contain multiple properties; neighbouring municipalities are separate sources.
sources.attribution: IDECA/UAECD Lote — December 2021, served by CAR, CC BY 4.0. Adapted to canonical WGS84 parcel features.

sources.name: Los Angeles County Assessor parcels
sources.scope: Los Angeles County only; county assessor polygons do not establish coverage of adjacent counties or separate condominium title boundaries.
sources.attribution: County of Los Angeles, Assessor parcels. Enterprise GIS Repository. Accessed October 2, 2026. Adapted to WGS84.

sources.name: Miami-Dade County Property Appraiser parcels
sources.scope: Miami-Dade County only; does not cover Broward or Palm Beach counties. Property assessment polygons are approximate.
sources.attribution: Miami-Dade County GIS, Property Appraiser parcels. Adapted to WGS84.
sources.licenceNote: Official public dataset supplies data for use subject to an accuracy/reliance disclaimer; no named open-data licence is stated.

sources.name: District of Columbia DCGIS tax lots
sources.scope: District of Columbia assessment tax lots, not legal survey/record lots. SSL numbers are not unique; each GlobalID identifies a separate polygon. Adjacent Virginia and Maryland jurisdictions need separate sources.
sources.attribution: District of Columbia, DCGIS Tax Lots, CC BY 4.0. Adapted to WGS84.

sources.name: France IGN/DGFiP Parcellaire Express (PCI)
sources.scope: IGN assembly of vectorised DGFiP cadastral parcels across France; Paris and Lyon bounded samples verified. Non-vectorised areas and cadastral alignment gaps remain possible; globe enables Paris only.
sources.attribution: IGN/DGFiP, Parcellaire Express (PCI), catalogue and updates linked; accessed October 2, 2026. Licence Ouverte 2.0. Adapted to WGS84.

sources.name: Victoria Vicmap Parcel (PARCEL_MP)
sources.scope: Victoria cadastral parcel map polygons; distinct from local-government property assessment units. Other Australian states use separate datasets. Only Approved (A) parcel and version records are ground; Proposed (P) records are excluded. Crown and government-road parcels remain included. Only G (unrestricted ground) and S (ground surface affected by strata) levels are ground; above/below strata are excluded.
sources.attribution: State of Victoria, Department of Transport and Planning, Vicmap Parcel. CC BY 4.0. Adapted to WGS84.

sources.name: City of Cape Town Land Parcels
sources.scope: City of Cape Town municipal cadastral parcels; duplicate address rows with the same SG26 code and identical geometry collapse to one parcel. Conflicting geometry fails closed. Other South African municipalities use separate sources.
sources.attribution: City of Cape Town, Land Parcels. Adapted to WGS84.
sources.licenceNote: Official public open-data item; named reuse licence not established. Linked City open-data terms page returned 404 at verification.
